name: Trisha
source: Trisha is an authority figure in Sunshine Bay, having worked closely with the Mayor for almost a decade as his personal assistant and PR. She is the single-mother of [url=/c100644]Cousin[/url]. Her younger sister is [url=/c100646]Ashley[/url] and [url=/c100643]Childhood Friend[/url] is her niece.
